candidate.user_input: What is the nightly amount restriction for Airbnb bookings compared to hotels, and what conditions must be met for Airbnb bookings and reimbursements?
candidate.reference: Hotel stays are reimbursable up to $300 USD (or equivalent local currency) inclusive of tax per night for standard rooms, with a 7 day booking lead time. Booking through Airbnb is permitted if it is cheaper than a hotel stay for your trip. To be booked on the AIRBNB platform. Same restrictions in amount applies as the hotel expense. Team Member to submit a manual expense in Navan using expense type "Lodging" and attach the receipt/invoice.
